| Date | |
|---|---|

| **February 1, 2027** | SOPHAS deadline |
| **March 1, 2027** | All materials due, including the UMass supplemental application |

[Apply at sophas.org](https://sophas.org){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

## Prerequisites

| Course | |
|---|---|
| Calculus I and II | Required |
| Calculus III (multivariable) | Recommended |
| Linear algebra | Recommended |

## What you'll submit

1. A **SOPHAS application** with a personal statement.
2. **Official transcripts.** Admitted students typically have a GPA of 3.0 or higher.
3. **Three letters of recommendation**, plus a résumé or CV.
4. The **UMass supplemental application.** The link is emailed to you after you submit in SOPHAS.

The **GRE is not required**. International applicants may need an English proficiency test; see the Graduate School website.

[Official admissions page](https://www.umass.edu/public-health-sciences/academics/biostatistics/graduate-admissions-biostatistics)

## Costs & scholarships

- **Merit scholarships:** last year's awards were about **\$5,000 per year, for 2 years**.
- **Affordable:** UMass graduate degrees are cost-effective, especially for Massachusetts residents. See [graduate tuition rates](https://www.umass.edu/bursar/tuition/graduate-tuition).
- **Assistantships:** some TA/RA positions are available, but they are usually not guaranteed for MS students.

## Undergraduates: try biostatistics first

Our **Summer Workshop in Biostatistics** is a 2-week program in June for 15–20 undergraduates, with a **\$1,000 stipend**. It includes lectures and hands-on labs with UMass faculty and PhD students, statistical computing in R, guest speakers from academia and industry, and advice on career paths. Lunch is provided and on-campus housing is available. It's open to undergraduates who have completed at least one year of study.

We ran it in June 2024 and 2025 and hope to offer it again in summer 2027. [Workshop page](https://www.umass.edu/public-health-sciences/academics/biostatistics/summer-workshop-biostatistics) · Questions: [rbalasub@umass.edu](mailto:rbalasub@umass.edu)
